description: E2 Dropout Risk Cross-Check — compares E2 trial-specific signal against Drop badge phase baseline
drop_badge_source: Phase + sponsor tier — historical phase transition rates
e2_source: Trial-specific signals — endpoint type, design, enrollment velocity, expedited pathway

flag_types.consistent: E2 and Drop within 1 point — signals agree
flag_types.e2_higher: E2 > Drop by 2+ points — hidden risk not captured by phase baseline
flag_types.e2_lower: E2 < Drop by 2+ points — trial-specific factors reduce risk below baseline

platform_display.molecule_card: E2 badge shown next to Drop badge: 'Drop 2/5 | E2 🟡'
platform_display.conflict_flag: ⚠️ shown when flag = e2_higher or e2_lower
platform_display.gantt_chart: E2 score modifies bar opacity — score 4-5 = faded bars with warning icon
platform_display.full_intelligence_profile: Cross-check narrative in Pipeline Intelligence Summary card

cross_check_logic:
Cross-check E2 vs Drop badge.
    Returns: agreement level, narrative, flag type
